items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: There's Dick Smith on cornet... Yes. ... Conrad Janis, Dick Smith, Tom Sharpstein, Danny Barker was playing guitar... Do you remember that date in New York? Mmm-hmm. Yes.

ctx.x: No, I didn't get a chance to talk with many of them. I was always going out to work. I worked so hard! So I might get up at about eleven o'clock and get me something to eat, and come right back and get into bed again. Because that was a hard job. I had to keep all my health and strength together. I always had... All the bandleaders and everybody I worked with always said I had a good foot, you know, a good ride foot.

When you got back to New York, then, you started working with Conrad Janis. And that eventually led to some recordings of Conrad Janis and His Tailgate Jazz Band. This is in November of 1950. There's Dick Smith on cornet...,
